entities.summary: Alyona Ivanivna Shkrum is a Ukrainian politician, lawyer, human rights activist, public figure. She was from 2014 to December 2024 a member of the Verkhovna Rada for the All-Ukrainian Union "Fatherland". On 3 December 2024 she was appointed Deputy-Minister of Communities and Territories Development.
